crossProgramFindings.pricingCoverage: Only the summer camp publishes a price. Neither the flagship 90-Day Stage Program nor private lessons, group lessons, Band Builders or Early Childhood publish any tuition figure.
crossProgramFindings.durationCoverage: Only the camp states session length. Lesson duration is never stated for any lesson-based program.
crossProgramFindings.guaranteeCoverage: The Stage-Ready Guarantee is stated on 2 pages (homepage, /resources/) and on none of the 6 program pages.
crossProgramFindings.scholarshipCoverage: PEP/UA are mentioned on 1 of 6 program pages (/private-lessons/).
crossProgramFindings.programInterlinking: Zero. No program page links to any other program page. The 90-Day Stage Program, Private Lessons and Band Builders form one product per /resources/, yet none of the three references the others.
crossProgramFindings.navigationGaps: Group Music Lessons and Singing Lessons are live but absent from the nav and from /programs/. The nav's 'Summer Programs' link points to /summer-jam-music-camp-2026/ while the /programs/ card for the same label points to /summer-programs/.
